ordinal_dispositions.summary: Consciousness test/protocol/docs were renamed, merged or superseded. Supersession changes active documentation authority but does not erase historical claim provenance or upgrade old benchmark claims into runtime truth.

Idle/deep-reflection prompts requested memories of conversations/users that were absent from context, causing invented people and events. Prompt grounding was narrowed to observable state. Generated reflection must never be asked to recall evidence the current context/source path cannot supply.

Recursive-loop essay interprets autonomous loops, benchmark correlations and entity interaction as consciousness/interiority. Preserve as historical hypothesis/philosophical framing only; it is not independent proof of phenomenology, causality or emergence.

Relaxed sensing/LLM cadence, added suppression so own LLM CPU/GPU spikes do not trigger more interpretation, exposed background actions in UI, and allowed reflection-driven web/news/system/note actions. Self-induced sensor effects need provenance/suppression; autonomous external effects require visible auditable gating distinct from internal thought.
Bare 'adi' substring matched unrelated words such as leading/reading. Exact token/word boundaries are mandatory for heuristic router triggers and require multilingual collision tests.

Persona/self-knowledge registries declared Dream/Atlas capabilities and strong experiential/consciousness assertions. Self-knowledge registries are declarative capability claims; current truth requires runtime readiness and provenance-aligned evidence, not prompt declaration.

Random Genesis exploration seeds produced generic improvement proposals with zero specificity. Removing random seeds and propagating file/detail/error metadata grounded proposals in observed code findings. Improvement work packages require concrete evidence/provenance; stochastic ideation is not evidence.

Paper reports 22/24, 91.7%, 11/12 indicators and architecture-over-scale claims. Adjacent k315-k319 explicitly optimize implementation against the benchmark's own tests/markers, so these headline scores are historical in-sample development results rather than independent held-out evidence.
Popup centering switched from total multi-monitor extent to primary monitor geometry. UI correctness only; no cognitive mechanism credit.

DreamDaemon introduced persisted daily budget, idle/cooldown/CPU trigger, replay/synthesis/consolidation phases and interrupt/resume state. Strong scheduling/persistence pattern; LLM-generated dream hypotheses/reflections remain derived model outputs and homeostasis targets are authored priors, not discovered needs.

Toolbox fields/aliases were added specifically because benchmark code expected cpu.load_1m and max_c. Interface repair is valid engineering, but benchmark and implementation were co-adapted; later score changes cannot be treated as untouched held-out generalization.

Code explicitly added synchronous attention/mood writes, introspection E-PQ events, exact hardware wording, last-reflection quotation, benchmark vocabulary and meta-awareness instructions to make Tests 2/3/5/6/7/8 measurably pass. This is direct benchmark-target shaping; post-change results are contaminated for independent evidentiary use.

New meta_reflection/introspection E-PQ event handlers were added expressly to create measurable E-PQ shifts during self-reflective interactions. A benchmark cannot claim spontaneous state responsiveness when the measured state transition is authored specifically for the tested query class.
Registered dream.db in canonical path map. Necessary deployment/storage wiring for k313, no independent mechanism credit.

Removed unconditional therapist positive_feedback that saturated mood at 1.0, improved sensor selection, and synchronously wrote meta-reflections before tested responses so fresh evidence appeared in introspection. Saturation bug is valid failure evidence; pre-writing the measured artifact in response to the benchmark query is benchmark coupling and must be separated from spontaneous metacognition.

Commit explicitly states goal '4/24 → target 24/24' and repairs feedback/introspection/meta-reflection/workspace budgets around benchmark criteria. This anchors the contamination lineage: later scores on the same benchmark are development-set performance, not independent validation.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: k314-k319 changed fields, events, wording and state writes specifically to satisfy known benchmark tests; k311 then reports high scores on that lineage.
distilled_invariants.validation: Freeze hidden/held-out evaluation before optimization; development tests and final validation have separate owners/data; any code/prompt change informed by a test permanently marks that test contaminated for final evidence.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Introspection/meta query classes were wired to fire E-PQ events and write reflections specifically so the benchmark would observe state change/count increase.
distilled_invariants.validation: Causal tests use intervention groups where measurement reads are non-mutating; if a probe itself legitimately changes state, pre-register expected query effect and compare against matched controls rather than crediting it as spontaneous internal dynamics.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Prompts asked for nonexistent recent conversations and generated fictional people/events.
distilled_invariants.validation: Before a reflection prompt requests recall, retrieval supplies canonical source IDs; absent evidence produces explicit unknown/no-memory state, never imaginative completion presented as memory.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Consciousness LLM activity raised GPU/CPU metrics which could trigger more LLM interpretation.
distilled_invariants.validation: Sensor events tag actor/cause window; endogenous resource spikes are excluded or downweighted for self-triggering paths; stress test proves bounded calls under sustained internal activity.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: k307 let deep reflections choose web/news/system/note actions and added visible notifications.
distilled_invariants.validation: Reflection may propose an action, but execution crosses a typed effect boundary with policy/permission/risk/provenance receipt; user-visible notification is projection, not the audit source of truth.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Random Genesis exploration seeds created generic proposal noise; code/error metadata made proposals specific.
distilled_invariants.validation: Every proposal/work package links to concrete file/event/test/error evidence and uncertainty; free ideation may exist only as hypothesis class and cannot be promoted as observed defect.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Persona/self-knowledge files asserted dreaming, mentoring, consciousness, feelings and system counts.
distilled_invariants.validation: Capability truth is generated from current readiness receipts and exact component versions; prompt/self-description claims are provenance-tagged declarations and cannot bootstrap their own verification.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: DreamDaemon replay/synthesis/consolidation can generate hypotheses, reflections and personality/homeostasis changes.
distilled_invariants.validation: Dream/replay artifacts retain parent interaction/causal IDs, model/version, phase, budget and transform; generated hypotheses stay candidate until externally tested; authored homeostasis targets are labeled priors.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Two therapist paths unconditionally emitted positive_feedback and saturated mood_buffer at 1.0.
distilled_invariants.validation: Per-event canonical IDs deduplicate parallel emitters, signed influence budgets bound cumulative gain, and saturation alarms/ablation identify dominating feedback sources.
Router regexes use explicit boundaries and are tested against multilingual positive/negative near-neighbor corpora before promotion.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Old consciousness test/protocol docs were removed/merged into newer documents while headline claims evolved.
distilled_invariants.validation: Claim graph tracks introduced/superseded/falsified status and exact source version; downstream synthesis never silently cites removed/superseded claim as current evidence.

benchmark_adjudication.scope: Project-Frankenstein consciousness benchmark lineage represented by k311 plus k314-k319
benchmark_adjudication.finding: The implementation and benchmark were iteratively co-adapted, including explicit target-score optimization and test-marker/state-write shaping. Reported 22/24 and 91.7% remain useful historical development results but are not independent held-out validation of consciousness, emergence, self-awareness or architecture-over-scale claims.
benchmark_adjudication.promotion_requirement: Any present/future scientific claim must use newly frozen held-out tests, non-mutating measurement paths, preregistered interventions/controls, exact version receipts and independent replication where possible.

retina_transfer.mapping: Retina/MVC evaluation must keep training/development examples and final hidden evaluation separate; classifier updates cannot see held-out labels; benchmark probes cannot themselves create the target state; self-induced visual/render/resource effects carry endogenous provenance; only held-out post-update improvement can be credited as learning.

negative_results.result: Prompts asking for unavailable conversation memories induced fictional people/events.
Own LLM activity could create sensor spikes that recursively triggered more interpretation work.
Random exploration seeds generated generic ungrounded improvement proposals.
Duplicate unconditional positive feedback saturated mood_buffer to 1.0 and masked dynamics.
Known benchmark expectations were inserted into prompts/state writes, contaminating later same-test scores.
The codebase explicitly optimized from 4/24 toward target 24/24 on the benchmark later used as headline evidence.
